text: I, MAJDI “GAITH” ABUHAMDIEH, hereby declare that I am a candidate for an elective office in the City of Berkeley, and make the following statement:
1. That my name is Majdi “Gaith” Abuhamdieh
2. The office for which I am a candidate is Berkeley City Council, District 4
3. That my residence is 1805 Bonita St Berkeley, CA 94709
4. The place of my birth is Ohlone Land (San Francisco, California)
5. My present occupation is Trust and Safety Policy, Small Business Owner
6. I have held the following public offices: Peace and Justice Commissioner, City of Berkeley

7. Record of community service: Community organizer advancing interfaith and multicultural initiatives; organized charity runs, rides, and service events bringing communities together while supporting youth, families, and marginalized communities.
8. I am a taxpayer in the City of Berkeley.

9. I am Majdi Gaith, an independent progressive, former Peace and Justice Commissioner, Trust and Safety policy professional, small business co-founder, parent, and UC Berkeley graduate running for Berkeley City Council, District 4. For more than a decade, I have developed policies that protect millions of people from harassment, fraud, abuse, and emerging threats. This work taught me how to evaluate evidence, solve complex problems, build consensus, and make balanced decisions that strengthen public trust. I am building a multicultural, multifaith, and multigenerational coalition because Berkeley is strongest when people from every background and generation work together. As the co-founder of a local coffee roasting business and bakery, I understand the challenges facing small businesses, workers, and our neighborhood commercial corridors. As a parent raising a family in Berkeley, I know every resident deserves safe streets, reliable city services, attainable housing, and the opportunity to thrive. I will bring thoughtful leadership, fiscal responsibility, transparency, and integrity to City Hall. I will work to revitalize downtown and our neighborhood commercial corridors, strengthen tenant protections, support workers and local businesses, expand housing opportunities, improve public safety, advance climate action, and ensure Berkeley’s government is accountable, responsive, and committed to protecting the rights, dignity, and opportunity of every resident.

text: I, IGOR A. TREGUB, hereby declare that I am a candidate for an elective office in the City of Berkeley, and make the following statement:
1. That my name is Igor A. Tregub
2. The office for which I am a candidate is Berkeley City Council, District 4
3. That my residence is 2434A McKinley Ave., Berkeley, CA 94703
4. The place of my birth is Kyiv, Ukraine
5. My present occupation is Berkeley City Councilmember, District 4

6. I have held the following public offices: Berkeley City Councilmember, District 4; Berkeley Vice Mayor; Chair, Council Health, Life Enrichment, Equity & Community Policy Committee; Council Land Use, Housing, and Urban Development Policy Committee; Alternate, Council Budget & Finance Policy Committee; Berkeley Representative, Ava Community Energy Board of Directors; Chair, Ava Community Energy Marketing, Regulatory, and Legislative Committee; Vice Chair and Berkeley Representative, Alameda County Lead Poisoning Prevention Program Joint Powers Authority Board of Directors; Berkeley City Council Representative, Berkeley Behavior Health Commission; City Council/Rent Board 4*4 Committee; City/UC/Student Relations 4*6 Committee; Chair, AC Transit Parcel Tax Oversight Committee; Berkeley Rent Stabilization Boardmember; Chair, Berkeley Housing Advisory Commission; Chair, Berkeley Zoning Adjustments Board; Chair, Berkeley Measure O Oversight Committee; Chair, Berkeley Commission on Labor; Chair, Berkeley Peace and Justice Commission; Chair, Joint Committee on the Implementation of State Housing Laws; Berkeley Environment and Climate Commissioner; Berkeley Planning Commissioner; Berkeley Transportation Commissioner; Berkeley Unified School District Parcel Tax Oversight Committee; Chair Rent Board Budget & Personnel Committee

7. Record of community service: Berkeley Rotary; Boardmember, Sierra Club; Boardmember, UN Association-East Bay; Boardmember, Savo Island Cooperative; ASUC Senator; East Bay Housing Organizations; Water Education for Latino Leaders
8. I am a taxpayer in the City of Berkeley.

9. When you elected me two years ago, I promised to be accessible, attentive, and focused on solving our city’s most pressing needs. Together we secured new housing at every income level, including affordable homes downtown; advanced street safety and accessibility improvements across our district; brought Downtown commercial vacancies down to pre-pandemic levels while investing in our small businesses and the arts; and reopened Civic Center Park as a public commons that everyone can enjoy. Still, we face challenges, including significant federal budget cuts and rising costs. I’m placing my decades of experience to work for you. We must continue to advance homeownership opportunities and rentals that hardworking residents can afford, help the unhoused find the supportive housing and wraparound services they deserve, and implement safer, climate-resilient infrastructure. I’m proud to be endorsed by the Sierra Club, National Union of Healthcare Workers, Congresswoman Lateefah Simon, California Attorney General Rob Bonta, Mayor Adena Ishii, supermajorities of the City Council and Rent Board, every Berkeley School Boardmember, Supervisor Nikki Fortunato Bas, State Senators Jesse Arreguín and Aisha Wahab, Alameda County Sheriff Yesenia Sanchez our BART, AC Transit, East Bay Regional Parks, and East Bay Municipal Utility District directors, and 100+ neighbors and community leaders. We’re just getting started. I’d be honored to earn your vote for a full term so we can continue to make Berkeley a place we can all call home. www.IgorTregub.com
